prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A middle-aged man stands indoors against a muted gray wall, wearing a white virtual reality headset that covers his eyes and upper face. He has short, dark hair and a slight stubble. A lit cigarette hangs from his lips, adding a sense of nonchalance to his demeanor. Around his neck rests a pair of white over-ear headphones, their cord loosely draped over his light lavender sweater vest and crisp white dress shirt. The man’s posture is upright and still, his expression obscured by the VR headset, evoking a sense of detachment or immersion in a digital world.

In the background, a large, bold poster dominates the left side of the frame. The poster features a grayscale image of a person with exaggerated, surprised eyes, wearing glasses, and the text “RADIO 4 LIFE!” in white, along with a red section below that reads “SWEET ENERGY DRINK!” and a stylized logo. To the right, a string of white triangular pennant flags adds a subtle festive touch, contrasting with the otherwise minimalist and subdued setting.

The color palette is cool and desaturated, with soft, even lighting that creates minimal shadows and a flat, almost clinical atmosphere. The composition is balanced, with the man positioned slightly off-center, drawing attention to both his futuristic accessories and the quirky background elements. The overall style is reminiscent of a deadpan, contemporary cinematic portrait, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the subject while gently blurring the background details. The mood is surreal and slightly absurd, blending mundane reality with digital escapism.
